title: Any-Order GPT as Masked Diffusion Model: Decoupling Formulation and Architecture

summary.en: Studies masked diffusion and standard autoregressive modeling in a decoder-only architectural framework, separating generation-order choices from network design. Experiments investigate parallel decoding, temperature annealing, and the resulting quality–compute tradeoffs.
summary.zh: 在 decoder-only 架构下比较掩码扩散与标准自回归建模，将生成顺序的选择与网络架构的影响分开研究。论文进一步考察并行解码、温度退火及其生成质量与计算开销之间的权衡。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of Any-Order GPT: Any-order modeling; Decoder-only backbone; Parallel decoding.
